Evidence Needed: user access is reviewed against documented role requirements.
Example Evidence Artifact: Access review export, RBAC matrix, group membership report
Validation Method: review date, access scope, approval notes, and removed access where applicable.

Evidence Needed: privileged accounts are separated, strongly authenticated, and reviewed.
Example Evidence Artifact: Privileged group export, MFA configuration evidence, privileged access review notes
Validation Method: privileged groups, MFA enforcement, separate admin accounts, and documented review notes.

Evidence Needed: network zones are defined and inter-zone traffic is restricted by approved rules.
Example Evidence Artifact: Network diagram, VLAN list, firewall rule export, approved traffic matrix
Validation Method: network zones match the diagram and firewall rules match the approved traffic matrix.
Frequency / Trigger: After network changes or annual review

Evidence Needed: remote access is authenticated, limited, and does not provide unnecessary internal reachability.
Example Evidence Artifact: VPN user list, remote access policy, MFA evidence, firewall/VPN configuration
Validation Method: remote access users, MFA enforcement, VPN/firewall configuration, and access restrictions.

Evidence Needed: critical authentication, firewall, endpoint, and administrative events are collected and reviewed.
Example Evidence Artifact: SIEM log source list, sample alerts, alert review notes, ingestion validation
Validation Method: listed log sources are actively ingesting events and alerts are reviewed.
Frequency / Trigger: Monthly or after log source changes

Evidence Needed: backups are performed and restore procedures are tested.
Example Evidence Artifact: Backup job logs, restore test report, validation notes
Validation Method: restore test date, system or dataset restored, result, reviewer, and follow-up actions.
Frequency / Trigger: Quarterly or after major system change

Evidence Needed: segmentation and firewall changes are documented and approved.
Example Evidence Artifact: Change request, approval record, firewall change log, baseline configuration
Validation Method: change request, approval record, implementation date, and baseline update.

Evidence Needed: identified weaknesses are tracked to completion with owners, target dates, and closure evidence.
Example Evidence Artifact: POA&M tracker, remediation notes, closure evidence, validation record
Validation Method: POA&M item has owner, target date, status, remediation notes, and closure evidence.
